lines: "Sorry. You'll be the one who went up the mine," a man says through the door. "It came round with the milk. I'm sorry, we still don't open."
"Sorry. We don't open after the bell, and not much before it," a man says, close to the wood. "No offence to you. The Arms will have you, on the square."

lines.text: "Sorry, you'll be the one who found Mr Ames his spectacles," a man says through the door. "It came round with the milk. We still don't open, I'm afraid."
